articles._summary: The S&P 500 Index has wavered in the last month as energy and artificial intelligence stocks pulled back. articles.headline: Ukraine hits major oil terminal in Russia's St Petersburg
articles.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky says the target is key infrastructure "that generates revenue for Russia's war".
articles._summary: Ukraine's military described St Petersburg's oil terminal as "one of the largest" in Russia Ukraine has struck a major oil terminal in Russia's second city of St Petersburg and other targets in the country's north-west. In a post on social media, President Volodymyr Zelensky wrote: "Ukraine's defence forces struck port oil infrastructure that generates revenue for Russia's war." He also said an "important military target" was hit overnight in Kronstadt, a nearby naval base. St Petersburg Governor Aleksandr Beglov said the city was under a "massive" drone attack, admitting the oil terminal was hit. He reported no casualties. Ukraine has in recent months intensified its long-range drone attacks on Russia's critical energy infrastructure, causing fuel shortages in a number of regions. In his post on Saturday morning, Zelensky said the targets hit in St Petersburg and the surrounding region were about 850km (528 miles) from Ukraine's border.

articles.headline: Iran begins dayslong funeral for the late Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei
articles.summary: Iran began a dayslong funeral Saturday for the late Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, months after an airstrike killed him at the start of the war. He was 86.
articles._summary: A crowd attends the start of the dayslong funeral ceremonies at the Imam Khomeini Mosalla Grand Mosque in Tehran, Iran, Saturday, July 4, 2026. Altaf Qadri/AP hide caption TEHRAN, Iran — Iran began a dayslong funeral Saturday for the late Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, months after an airstrike killed him at the start of the war. He was 86. Authorities unveiled the casket containing Khamenei's body in a glass case at the Grand Mosalla in Tehran, Iran's capital. Mourners wept at the sight, with some chanting: "Our word is one! Revenge! Revenge!" Some carried banners and flags, while billboards across the city bore Khamenei's image. Crowds of men rhythmically beat their chests in mourning, a common practice at Shiite funerals. "I am here to say goodbye to my beloved leader Ali Khamenei," said a weeping Hananeh Mousavi, 27, who attended the funeral alongside her mother. "I never expected to see such a day. I wish I had died before this tragedy."
articles._zh_headline: 伊朗为已故最高领袖阿亚图拉阿里哈梅内伊举行为期几天的葬礼
articles._zh_summary: 2026 年 7 月 4 日星期六，伊朗德黑兰伊玛目霍梅尼·莫萨拉大清真寺，一群人参加为期一天的葬礼。Altaf Qadri/美联社隐藏标题栏 伊朗德黑兰 — 伊朗于星期六开始为已故最高领袖阿亚图拉阿里·哈梅内伊举行为期一天的葬礼，几个月前，他在战争开始时的一次空袭中丧生。他享年 86 岁。当局在伊朗首都德黑兰大摩萨拉酒店的玻璃柜中揭开了装有哈梅内伊遗体的棺材。哀悼者看到这一幕流下了眼泪，一些人高喊着：“我们的诺言是一致的！复仇！复仇！”一些人举着横幅和旗帜，而整个城市的广告牌上都印有哈梅内伊的形象。成群的男人有节奏地捶胸以示哀悼，这是什叶派葬礼上的常见做法。 “我来这里是为了向我敬爱的领袖阿里·哈梅内伊告别，”27 岁的哈纳内·穆萨维 (Hananeh Mousavi) 哭泣着说道，她与母亲一起参加了葬礼。 “我没想到会看到这一天。我希望我在这场悲剧发生之前就死了。”
